components.name: button
components.label: Button
components.description: Displays a button or a component that looks like a button.

components.name: card
components.label: Card
components.description: Displays a card with header, content, and footer.

components.name: dialog
components.label: Dialog
components.description: A window overlaid on either the primary window or another dialog window.

components.name: badge
components.label: Badge
components.description: Displays a badge or a component that looks like a badge.

components.name: form
components.label: Form
components.description: Composable form field primitives — FormField, FormLabel, FormHelperText, and FormMessage.

components.name: spinner
components.label: Spinner
components.description: An animated loading indicator. Supports four sizes and eight color variants.

components.name: skeleton
components.label: Skeleton
components.description: A placeholder that mimics content layout while data loads.

components.name: separator
components.label: Separator
components.description: A thin line that visually divides content. Supports horizontal and vertical orientations.

components.name: avatar
components.label: Avatar
components.description: Displays a user avatar with image, initials fallback, color variants, status indicators, and group stacking.

components.name: accordion
components.label: Accordion
components.description: A vertically stacked set of collapsible sections with animated open/close and three visual variants.

components.name: progress
components.label: Progress
components.description: A progress bar with size, color, striped, and indeterminate variants.

components.name: breadcrumb
components.label: Breadcrumb
components.description: A navigation trail showing the user's location in a hierarchy. Supports custom separators, collapsed items, and framework-agnostic links.

components.name: pagination
components.label: Pagination
components.description: Controls for navigating between pages of content. Supports active states, ellipsis for large ranges, and framework-agnostic links.

components.name: sidebar
components.label: Sidebar
components.description: A collapsible vertical navigation panel with icon-rail mode, grouped links, badges, and a composable header/footer.

components.name: navigation-menu
components.label: Navigation Menu
components.description: A horizontal navigation bar with animated dropdown panels. Supports grouped links, rich content, and keyboard navigation.

components.name: stepper
components.label: Stepper
components.description: A step-by-step progress indicator. Composable pieces — indicator, title, description, separator — for horizontal and vertical layouts.
